checklist: cert/import.mjs: import nacl 1.6.2 from /node_modules/@ai-ecoverse/py-pynacl, found by discovery without PYTHONPATH, no nested python; nacl._sodium (its one side module) imports, with _cffi_backend from @ai-ecoverse/py-cffi; importlib.metadata.version('pynacl') is 1.6.2

cert/sealedbox.mjs: az's _encrypt_github_actions_secret (azure-cli 2.93.0 appservice/custom.py, verbatim: PublicKey from a base64 repo key, SealedBox.encrypt, base64) on a UTF-8 secret; two seals differ; the recipient's SealedBox decrypts both; a box sealed by a native libsodium opens; the wrong key and a flipped byte raise CryptoError

cert/box.mjs: nacl.public.Box (RFC 7748 keys, fixed nonce) and nacl.secret.SecretBox ciphertexts equal a native libsodium's; decrypt; a flipped byte and a wrong key raise CryptoError; SecretBox with a random nonce; nacl.secret.Aead (XChaCha20-Poly1305) round trip, wrong AD raises; ChaCha20-Poly1305 IETF RFC 8439 2.8.2 through nacl.bindings

cert/signing.mjs: nacl.signing Ed25519 RFC 8032 tests 1 and 2 (public keys and signatures), verify (also from a base64 VerifyKey), BadSignatureError on a changed message, generate/sign/verify, to_curve25519_public_key

cert/pwhash.mjs: nacl.pwhash argon2id/argon2i kdf at t=3 m=8 MiB against Node's crypto.argon2; argon2id OPSLIMIT/MEMLIMIT_INTERACTIVE (2, 64 MiB) MODERATE (3, 256 MiB) and SENSITIVE (4, 1 GiB) known answers (Node's crypto.argon2); nacl.pwhash.str ($argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=2,p=1$) and verify, InvalidkeyError on a wrong password; scrypt RFC 7914 (N=1024, r=8, p=16) and scrypt.str/verify

cert/utils.mjs: nacl.utils.random (libsodium randombytes_buf = arc4random_buf keyed from WASI random_get): three 32-byte draws differ and are non-zero, 1 MiB at once; randombytes_deterministic, SHA-256/512('abc'), BLAKE2b-512 plain and keyed (Node crypto), SipHash-2-4, X25519 RFC 7748 known answers; has_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256 and has_crypto_core_ed25519 (a full libsodium)
cert/notices.mjs: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md names libsodium (ISC), linked statically into nacl/_sodium, with its licence text

build.sh: nacl/_sodium.c is generated by scripts/cffi-wasix.sh with cffi 2.1.1 (py-cffi's pin; build.sh refuses a py-cffi dependency of another release) from PyNaCl's own src/bindings/build.py and linked with wasix-libsodium 1.0.22-1's lib-pic/libsodium.a; every function the side module imports is exported by wasix-python 3.15.0-1's python.wasm, and no libsodium symbol is left to the loader
python-range.mjs (homescoop#702): the tarball takes wasix-python >=3.15.0-1 <3.15.1; the specs run on 3.15.0-1 and 3.15.0-8
pip: pynacl is in scripts/homescoop-pydata-map.json (native, @ai-ecoverse/py-pynacl) and PIP_PENDING until the wasix-python release that adds it to _slicc_pip.py
